questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All chain are bracelet.

All bracelet are ring.

Some ring are tops.

Conclusions:

(1) All chain are ring.

(II) Some tops are chain.
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c5832b1b7cb4ad4f9d30201b4387937663f2cdc68c9073fde55b01ea164585b.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(1) All chain are ring - True(because, all chain are bracelet and all bracelet are ring, it implies that all chain can be rings).

(II) Some tops are chain - False(because, there is no direct relation is given between them, so it can be possible only).

Thus, Only conclusion (1) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
